_what_this_is: THE RATCHET. Protected, so only a human commit can move these numbers. The gate asserts observed >= floor, and a second check asserts floor(head) >= floor(base) - so 'delete the assertion and lower the number in the same commit' is not available.
_slack_is_zero_here_on_purpose: Measured floors should be set equal to what the harness observes, not below it. For new structural floors, the committed catalogue itself can justify a higher acceptance threshold before the first VPS observation: if the environment cannot clear it, the gate stays red rather than silently accepting the older baseline.
_measured_2026_08_13: python harness/ci.py --quick -> STATIC_OK, UNIT_PASSED tests=549 (390 backend pytest + 159 frontend vitest). .factory/holdout/run.py -> HOLDOUT_PASSED scenarios=3 assertions=9. harness/mutations/run.py -> MUTATIONS_TOTAL=4 MUTATIONS_CAUGHT=4 MUTATIONS_NOT_INJECTED=0.
_structural_ratchet_2026_08_24: The protected mutation catalogue now contains nine defects. Three new security/dependency/governance defects declare must_catch=[security], so a successful run must report at least 9 total mutations, at least 3 independent catches, and at least 3 security catches. These are acceptance floors derived from committed structure; they are not represented as a claimed VPS execution result. After the first VPS run, raise any measured counts that exceed these floors in the same human-reviewed change.
_e2e_steps_deliberately_absent: There is no e2e floor here because the number has never been measured. harness/e2e.py asserts five HTTP-level checks, but running them needs the validation env that lives outside the repo, and this machine does not have it. Writing 5 here would be a floor nobody has ever observed the harness clear - which is the same class of claim this whole directory exists to refuse. Measure it on the VPS, then add the line.
_independence_history_2026_08_13: Of the original four mutations, ONE was caught above the independence line (lock-key-is-constant, by the holdout). The current structural floor is stronger because the security probes are required to be caught by the deterministic security channel itself; an unrelated lint/test failure cannot earn credit for those probes.
_known_gap: No numeric floor covers the agent-browser journey in FACTORY_RULES section 4, because that journey still needs a measured VPS baseline. The validator does enforce APP_STARTED/E2E deterministically, but the count remains deliberately unratcheted until observed.
_raise_these: On the same human-reviewed change that accepts stronger assertions or records a newly measured higher baseline. If you find yourself lowering one, the question is what stopped being true.
